ValidationRule.description: Required fields when Change Profile is selected from Support Type pick-list
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Access_Request_Type__c, "Change Profile/Access"), $Profile.Name=="Eligibility Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Fiscal Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Provider Worker Supervisor", $Profile.Name=="Universal User", $Profile.Name=="CCCAP Program Internal Team", $Profile.Name=="System Administrator", $Profile.Name=="System Admin", $Profile.Name=="CHATS System Administrator", OR( ISBLANK(Email_Address__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(First_name__c), ISBLANK(Start_Deactivation_Change_Date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Is_this_staff_member_replacing_another__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Access_Level_Requested__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Change Access, please ensure that the following fields are compeleted: Start Date, First Name, Last Name, CHATS Supervisor, Access Level Requested, Changing Profile Only check-box, Is this staff member replacing another?; Email address.
